name: STERILE
source:
Follow five kids in their quest to not die!

STERILE is a visual novel set in an adolescent psych ward at a hospital, based on personal experiences of the developer and a few others.

[Edited from [url=https://squishymoss.itch.io/sterile]itch.io[/url]]
